headlines.title: 쪽방촌 찾은 구윤철 부총리 "폭염 취약계층 에 관심· 지원 지속할 것"

headlines.title: " 실거주 예외 최장 3년 …민의 반영해 보완검토"
headlines.summary: 구윤철 부총리 밝혀 정부가 장기거주소득공제를 도입하는 가운데 비거주 1주택자의 실거주 예외 인정과 관련한 제도를 재검토할 계획이다. 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관(사진)은 7일 MBC 라디오 인터뷰에서 "국회 논의 단계 등을 통해 국민 의견을 충분히 경청하겠다"며 "합리적인 범위 내에서는 얼마든지 의견을 반영할 것"이라고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: “ 비거주 1주택 예외인정 , 3년 보다 더 늘릴 수도”
headlines.summary: ■ 구윤철, 실거주 규제 완화 시사 “국민 의견 듣고 신축적으로 검토” 같은 시군 내 이동 인정 여부 관건 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 지난 6일 오전 서울 종로구 정부서울청사에서 열린 비상경제본부 회의 겸 경제ㆍ구조혁신 관계장관회의에서 발언하고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 16억 낮춘 급매 … 한강벨트는 올라
headlines.summary: 부동산 세제개편發 시장재편 "세금 오르기 전 빨리 팔자" 초고가 아파트 등 매물 늘어 마용성 아파트 가격 방어…李, 공급대책 최종점검 나서 정부가 8·3 세제개편안을 발표한 이후 서울 강남 초고가 단지에서 호가를 크게 낮춘 급매물이 나오기 시작했다. 실거주를 하더라도 보유세·양도세 부담이 커진 초고가 주택 소유자들이 절세를 위해 매도에 나선 것이다.

headlines.title: '공급 속도전' 위해 부동산 금융 규제 푼다
headlines.summary: 李 "주택공급 과감히 실천하라" 6시간 난상 토론 PF보증 확대 등 금융 지원 논의 이주비 대출규제 완화도 추진 "용산 부지, 서울시와 협의하라" 한성숙·구윤철·김용범 등 참석 이재명 대통령은 7일 '제3기 진실·화해를 위한 과거사정리위원회' 출범을 계기로 국가 폭력 피해자들을 청와대에 초청해 위로 오찬을 했다. 이 대통령이 인사말을 하고 있다.

headlines.title: 토허구역 실수요자 대출 규제 완화 검토
headlines.summary: 청년·신혼부부·갈아타기 등 대상 매수 자금 문턱 낮추는 핀셋 지원 연합뉴스 정부가 토지거래허가구역 안에서 무주택 청년과 신혼부부 등 실수요자를 대상으로 대출 규제를 일부 완화하는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 토허구역과 대출 규제가 겹치면서 투기 수요자뿐 아니라 실수요자도 자금 조달에 어려움을 겪는 부작용을 줄이려는 취지다.

headlines.title: 누가 웃고 누가 더 낼까… 세제 개편, 달라진 부동산 셈법
headlines.summary: [부동산 세제개편, 시장은 어디로]② 같은 30억원 집도 실거주·비거주·다주택 따라 세금 '천차만별' 같은 집값도 다른 세금…실거주 여부가 희비 갈랐다 서울 남산에서 바라본 서울시내 아파트 모습. [사진 연합뉴스] [이코노미스트 이승훈 기자] 서울에서 시가 20억원대 아파트에 10년째 살고 있는 A씨와 시가 50억원대 아파트를 보유한 B씨.

headlines.title: 구윤철 "30억 이하 1 주택 세부담 경감…상위 1%만 과세 정상화"

headlines.title: 저소득 신혼부부 '출산 지원금' 더 받는다

headlines.title: 美 “ 폴리실리콘 쓴 제품 15% 관세 ” 中저가공세 차단

headlines.title: 美, 반도체· 태양 광패널 원료에 15 % 관세 만지작… 韓기업들 긴장

top5_headlines.title: 美 “ 폴리실리콘 쓴 제품 15% 관세 ” 中저가공세 차단
top5_headlines.summary: 미국내 태양광 생산거점 확대 노려 韓 한화-OCI 등 반사이익 가능성 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령. 워싱턴=AP/뉴시스 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 6일(현지 시간) 반도체와 태양광의 핵심 재료인 웨이퍼 등 폴리실리콘 파생제품에 15% 관세를 부과한다는 포고령을 발표했다. 중국의 저가 공세를 막고 미국 내 태양광 생산 거점을 확대하기 위한 조치다.

key_headlines.title: US Imposes 15% Tariff on Polysilicon Products, Korean Semiconductor and Solar Companies in Focus
key_headlines.summary: The Trump administration announced a 15% tariff on polysilicon-derived products used in semiconductors and solar panels, aimed at blocking Chinese low-cost competition. Korean companies like Hanwha and OCI may benefit from increased US domestic production demand.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Relaxes Real Estate Finance Regulations to Accelerate Housing Supply
key_headlines.summary: President Lee Jae-myung held a 6-hour economic discussion to loosen real estate finance regulations, including expanded PF guarantees and relaxed relocation loan restrictions. The government aims to rapidly increase housing supply to address shortages.

key_headlines.title: Real Estate Tax Overhaul Creates Vastly Different Tax Burdens on Identical Properties
key_headlines.summary: New tax reforms result in dramatically different tax amounts for the same 3 billion won property depending on owner residency status and number of properties held. Property ownership details now significantly impact tax liability.

key_headlines.title: US July Employment Unexpectedly Declines by 23,000, Raising Rate Hold Expectations
key_headlines.summary: US employment fell by 23,000 in July against expectations, causing probability of September Federal Reserve rate hold to surge to 60% from 45%. Bond yields dropped and stock markets rose on reduced rate hike expectations.

key_headlines.title: SK Hynix Invests 54 Trillion Won in AI Memory Production to Meet Surging Demand
key_headlines.summary: SK Hynix announced major investments in Yongin and Cheongju facilities to expand DRAM and NAND production capacity, responding to explosive AI-driven memory demand. The company is positioning itself as a key supplier for the AI era.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Trump administration's announcement of 15% tariffs on polysilicon products is creating significant market implications for Korean semiconductor and solar companies. South Korea's government is aggressively loosening real estate finance regulations to accelerate housing supply, including expanded project financing guarantees and relaxed relocation loan restrictions. New real estate tax reforms are creating vastly different tax burdens on identical properties based on owner residency and ownership structure, fundamentally altering market dynamics. The government is simultaneously addressing the Yongsan Children's Garden debate regarding potential housing development to meet supply shortages. These interconnected policy moves reflect Korea's urgent focus on resolving housing supply constraints.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Unexpected weakness in US July employment data, with a 23,000 job loss against expectations of gains, has significantly shifted market expectations regarding Federal Reserve policy. The probability of a September rate hold surged to 60% from 45%, reflecting growing uncertainty about the economic trajectory. South Korea's central bank previously raised its base rate by 0.25 percentage points to 2.75% in July based on strong economic momentum and solid exports. International credit agencies are warning that weakness in Korea's stock market may have larger impacts on the real estate sector than the financial sector. Upcoming US inflation data releases on August 12th and 13th are expected to be critical determining factors for September monetary policy decisions.
sections.Financial Markets: US equity markets rose sharply following weaker-than-expected employment data, with investors interpreting reduced Fed rate hike probability as positive. Korean stock markets experienced significant volatility, with KOSPI falling over 4% on August 6th and KOSDAQ dropping below the 800 level despite recent two-day rebounds. The Korean won strengthened considerably against the dollar, falling from 1,550 won per dollar in early July to the 1,430 won range, driven by yield considerations despite stock market weakness. International investment banks suggest KOSPI remains capable of reaching the 10,000 level, characterizing recent declines as temporary adjustments rather than structural problems. Deposit money has surged 35.5 trillion won to safe havens as investors withdraw from volatile equity markets.
sections.Industry & Technology: The government launched economic structural innovation initiatives with Samsung establishing a new RX business promotion division and expanded focus on robotics development across multiple sectors. A domestically-developed AI semiconductor that adapts its characteristics to match input data speed has been created, reducing prediction errors by up to 40% compared to existing AI chips. The Industry and Climate Energy Environment Ministries signed an MOU to promote used battery industry development, establishing trading and history management platforms to remove regulatory barriers. Experts predict semiconductor sector weakness has peaked and expect August rebounds, with attention on power and shipbuilding stocks alongside high-dividend equities. Rainbow Robotics and other automation companies are gaining attention amid government robotics promotion initiatives.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul City submitted a report to the Presidential Office attributing housing supply shortages to past large-scale removal of redevelopment zones, proposing private redevelopment and reconstruction projects as key solutions. The government is actively discussing using Yongsan Children's Garden for housing supply despite conservation concerns, with public debate intensifying between green space preservation and housing shortage mitigation. Next week will see 4,808 housing units released for presale nationwide, including the Han River Puregio Riverfront project in Gimpo. The shift from long-term leases to monthly rentals is creating severe housing cost burdens for low-income households, with rent-to-income ratios rising significantly during conversions. Recent tax reform changes are materially affecting property investment calculations, with nonresidential single-property owners potentially receiving extended exemption periods beyond the current three years.
sections.International Economy: Trump reiterated attempts to remove Federal Reserve Governor Cook, reviving mortgage fraud allegations, as tensions escalate between the administration and the Fed over monetary policy. The 15% polysilicon tariff targets Chinese supply chains while reportedly offering preferential treatment to South Korean, Japanese, and European companies with tariff rates kept below 15%. Trump's approach of 'pressure first, negotiate later' strategy with China sets the stage for high-stakes negotiations with Xi Jinping scheduled for late August. US protectionist policies are creating unintended consequences, with American companies like Whirlpool suffering as Chinese media highlights policy limitations. The US is launching major initiatives to reduce critical mineral dependence on China, with 3 billion dollars in Defense Department funding committed to battery and mineral supply chain diversification.
sections.AI & Economy: SK Hynix announced a 54 trillion won investment in Yongin and Cheongju facilities to expand memory production capacity and meet explosive AI-driven demand for DRAM and NAND chips. Naver recorded second-quarter record revenues of 3.3888 trillion won, with AI-based advertising contributing over 60% of revenue growth, though operating profits declined 0.2% due to AI infrastructure investments. Major banks are identifying significant opportunities in corporate finance as power infrastructure investments surge due to AI expansion and data center development requirements. LG's AI Research Institute developed industry-specialized AI foundation models that outperformed Google and Alibaba in global institutional evaluations. Japan's major voice actors are pursuing legal action against unauthorized use of their voices by generative AI systems, raising intellectual property and publicity rights questions that economic ministries are addressing.
sections.Others: South Korea's Financial Supervisory Service and Korea Exchange are reviewing approval procedures for single-stock leveraged ETFs, with debate over whether approval timelines have been accelerated from standard 29-day reviews. Global central banks including South Korea are actively purchasing gold bullion at lower prices, with the Bank of Korea expanding gold holdings through ETF purchases and direct production facility acquisitions. Korean retail investors are increasingly betting on individual US technology stocks including Amazon and Micron, with semiconductor ETFs showing significant double-digit performance gains. The US is investing 3 billion dollars to reduce critical mineral dependencies on China through Defense Department initiatives targeting battery supply chain diversification. LG's industrial-specialized AI foundation models achieved superior performance ratings compared to major global competitors in independent evaluations.
